summary: Game crashes when three or more skeletons are about to release their arrows
description: If three or more entities start drawing their bows, right before they shoot the arrow to the target the game stops responding and just stays like that until you task manager it. This is really really bad because you would most likely encounter three skeletons at night plus anything that is used to bait in skeletons will crash the game.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Use `/summon minecraft:skeleton ~ ~ ~` three times to summon three skeletons near your position.
3. Wait for the skeletons to start drawing their bows and prepare to shoot arrows.
4. Observe that the game stops responding when the skeletons are about to release their arrows.
5. Note that the game remains unresponsive until you use Task Manager to close it.
Observed Behavior: When three or more skeletons begin drawing their bows to shoot arrows at a target, the game stops responding and freezes until manually closed via task manager. This issue is particularly problematic as it often occurs during nighttime when players are likely to encounter multiple skeletons simultaneously. Additionally, any method used to attract or bait skeletons into an area can also trigger this crash, significantly impacting gameplay experience.
Expected Behavior: When three or more skeletons are about to release their arrows, the game should remain stable and responsive. The skeletons should continue to draw their bows and shoot arrows at the target without causing any lag or crashes. Players can encounter multiple skeletons at night or use bait to attract them without experiencing any performance issues or forced exits.
